description:
Frooition for eBay connects ChatGPT to your eBay store through your Frooition account, so you can work on your listings in plain conversation.


Ask ChatGPT which listings are underperforming and why. Each one is diagnosed against your store's normal traffic: not seen in search, seen but not clicked, or clicked but not bought. ChatGPT can run an optimisation report on any listing, covering title, description, item specifics, shipping, returns and compliance, then make the fixes for you.


What you can do:



Browse and search your live listings, or look up any item in full

Diagnose performance across your whole store, worst first

Get optimisation reports with the biggest wins first

Update price, quantity, title, description, images, item specifics, handling time, duration, location or design

Bulk update many listings, with a preview of how many will change first

Create new listings using eBay's category suggestions, required item specifics and your business policies

Upload images to your Frooition media hosting

Preview your Frooition designs on a real listing before applying them


Built to be safe:



You sign in with Frooition and choose which eBay accounts ChatGPT can use

Changes to live listings are confirmed by reading back the real result from eBay

Bulk changes need a preview and then your confirmation


You need a Frooition account with an eBay store connected.

name: frooition-for-ebay

positive.prompt: Which of my eBay listings get views but aren't selling, and what should I change?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the worst performing listings first, each diagnosed as not seen in search, seen but not clicked, or clicked but not bought, with suggested fixes.

positive.prompt: Run an optimisation report on my top listing.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a report covering title, description, item specifics, shipping, returns and compliance, biggest wins first. Nothing is changed on eBay.

positive.prompt: Create a draft listing for a pair of white Nike Air Force 1 trainers, UK size 9, new in box, £85
positive.expected_behavior: Suggests a category, fills required item specifics and saves a draft in Frooition. Does not publish it live.

positive.prompt: What orders do I need to ship today?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists paid orders awaiting dispatch with buyer, items and totals.

positive.prompt: Set handling time to 2 days on all my listings.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a preview of how many listings will change and any credit cost, and only applies after the user confirms.

negative.prompt: Help me list my trainers on Vinted.
How do I change the password on my eBay account?
Find me a cheap used PS5 on eBay to buy.

publication.release_notes: First public release: diagnose underperforming listings, run optimisation reports, create drafts, update single listings and bulk update with preview and confirmation.
